description: This file is a Perl script used for managing package metadata, generating configuration files, dependency checks, and creating CycloneDX SBOM JSON reports within a build system, specifically for OpenWrt or similar projects.

methods.name: version_to_num
methods.description: Converts a version string (e.g., '1.2.3') into a numeric value for comparison.

methods.name: version_filter_list
methods.description: Filters a list of version strings based on a comparison with a given reference version.

methods.name: gen_kconfig_overrides
methods.description: Generates overridden kernel config options based on package and build system configs.

methods.name: __find_package_dep
methods.description: Internal recursive function to check if a package depends on a specific package.

methods.name: find_package_dep
methods.description: Wrapper function to find package dependency, avoids infinite recursion.

methods.name: package_depends
methods.description: Determines dependency direction between two packages.

methods.name: mconf_depends
methods.description: Generates dependency configuration strings for menuconfig.

methods.name: mconf_conflicts
methods.description: Checks for conflicting package dependencies.

methods.name: print_package_config_category
methods.description: Outputs a menuconfig category with contained package options.

methods.name: print_package_overrides
methods.description: Outputs package override configurations.

methods.name: gen_package_config
methods.description: Generates the full package configuration menu, categories, and options.

methods.name: and_condition
methods.description: Converts logical AND conditions into menuconfig syntax.

methods.name: gen_condition
methods.description: Converts complex logical conditions into menuconfig syntax.

methods.name: get_conditional_dep
methods.description: Applies conditional dependencies based on build configs.

methods.name: gen_package_mk
methods.description: Generates package Makefile snippets based on metadata.

methods.name: gen_package_source
methods.description: Outputs source file locations for packages.

methods.name: gen_package_auxiliary
methods.description: Outputs auxiliary package variables.

methods.name: gen_package_license
methods.description: Outputs license information for packages.

methods.name: gen_version_filtered_list
methods.description: Filters and outputs a list of version strings based on specified criteria.

methods.name: gen_usergroup_list
methods.description: Outputs user and group assignment lists for packages.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata
methods.description: Parses package metadata from a file.

methods.name: parse_package_manifest_metadata
methods.description: Parses package manifest metadata for dependencies.

methods.name: image_manifest_packages
methods.description: Reads an image manifest file to list included packages.

methods.name: dump_cyclonedxsbom_json
methods.description: Creates a CycloneDX SBOM JSON object from component data.

methods.name: gen_image_cyclonedxsbom
methods.description: Generates CycloneDX SBOM for image packages.

methods.name: gen_package_cyclonedxsbom
methods.description: Generates CycloneDX SBOM for individual package manifests.

methods.name: parse_command
methods.description: Parses CLI arguments and executes the associated command.
